record.passage: ABOUT US At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale. We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry. More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale. ABOUT THE ROLE The LangSmith team owns and builds LangChain's core platform for observability, evaluation, and production reliability of AI systems. From tracing and annotation to run rules, evaluations, and beyond, this team owns LangSmith end-to-end. If you want to define what great AI observability looks like at production scale, this is where that work gets done. We're looking for a Product Manager to own key parts of LangSmith. Building AI products is changing the way software teams work; LangSmith is the observability, evals and deployment platform that makes shipping reliable AI systems possible. WHAT YOU'LL DO This role sits at the intersection of user experience and production infrastructure. You'll partner with engineers to build features that feel intuitive while solving deeply technical problems: versioning complex prompt chains, debugging multi-step agent failures, or designing evaluation systems that scale from 10 to 10,000 test cases. You'll work directly with customers — from early-stage startups shipping their first agent to enterprises running mission-critical AI systems — to understand where the platform breaks down and what capabilities unlock new workflows. - Own the roadmap for a core area of the LangSmith platform. - Work with customers to understand their challenges and define new product features. - Work with engineering to define scope, make technical tradeoffs, and ship high-impact features quickly. - Help shape product strategy alongside our founders and leadership team. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 3+ years of product management or engineering experience, ideally building developer tools, infrastructure products, or technical SaaS platforms. - Deeply technical — you can hold your own in conversations about API design, system architecture, data pipelines, and debugging production issues. - Bias toward action — you'd rather ship, learn, and iterate than build the perfect solution upfront. - Strong written and verbal communicator who can align cross-functional teams around a shared vision. NICE TO HAVE - Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent technical background. - Previous experience at a high-growth startup or developer-focused company. - Hands-on experience building with LLMs, agents, or AI applications. COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations. BENEFITS Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

The round was led by existing investor CapitalG, with significant participation from new investors GIC and DFJ Growth and existing investors IVP and Sapphire Ventures. We believe agents will transform the economy. That future will be shaped by domain-specific agents differentiated by their knowledge, data, and UX. These agents will be sold as standalone products and also used to transform internal company operations. The companies that control these systems will build lasting competitive advantages. To capture that opportunity, every company will need to own its intelligence. Companies should be free to choose the best models for their needs, control their data and infrastructure, and continuously improve their agents, while maintaining the governance needed to operate securely at scale. That’s why we’ve built LangSmith, the framework-agnostic platform to run, improve, and govern agents . More than 7,000 organizations already rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups like Harvey, Rippling, and Listen Labs to Fortune 500 enterprises like NVIDIA, Toyota, and Salesforce. Clay uses LangSmith to monitor hundreds of millions of agent runs per month and improve their agents. Workday uses LangSmith to run and govern agents across the organization, reducing the time to deploy a new agent from five months to under a day. LangSmith provides the foundation for companies to control their agent systems across three pillars – Agent Runtime, Agent Improvement, and Agent Governance: Agent Runtime gives teams the architecture and infrastructure to run agents reliably. Deep Agents, LangGraph, and LangChain give developers flexibility across models and control over how context is managed. LangSmith Agent Server and Sandboxes allow teams to deploy and run agents securely at scale, whether in the cloud or in their environment. LangSmith Managed Agents and Fleet provide fully managed services to build, deploy, and run mission-critical agents in production. Agent Improvement helps teams test, monitor, and improve agent performance. LangSmith Observability and Evaluation give teams visibility into how agents behave and measure quality. LangSmith Engine, our in-platform agent, automates improvement by finding errors, writing code and prompt fixes, and monitoring production traffic for regressions. LangSmith Fine-Tuning helps teams turn agent traces into training data to fine-tune and evaluate specialized models. Agent Governance gives teams centralized control over how agents use models, tools, and data. Our LLM and Tool Gateways help teams manage model budgets and fallbacks, protect sensitive data, and govern tool access and authentication across teams and agents . On Friday, November 20th, we shared several new LangSmith capabilities that build on this foundation. Watch the recording of our special release event to see what’s coming next. LangSmith has been shaped by our fantastic community – from our developer evangelists to the customers we’re lucky enough to partner with. Thank you all for your feedback, insights, and trust. There’s still so much left to build. Building high performing agents is harder than it should be, and we‘re determined to change that. Come join us in making it easier for every company to own its intelligence. Harrison ‍ Thank you to our new and existing investors for helping make this journey possible. We’re excited to welcome Salesforce Ventures, Insight Venture Partners, QuantumLight, and MongoDB Ventures, and grateful to Sequoia, Amplify, and Benchmark for doubling down in this round. ‍ Related content Company Announcements Observability & Evals LangSmith for Coding Agents: Now track spend by outcome Jacob Lee November 18, 2026 8 min Company Announcements Protect sensitive data in your traces: new controls in LangSmith Trammell Saltzgaber November 17, 2026 5 min LangSmith Company Announcements New in LangSmith: Engine v2, Managed Deep Agents, Fine-Tuning, and More Jacob Talbot September 25, 2026 7 min Sign up for our newsletter to stay up to date Thank you! record.passage: ABOUT US At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale. We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry. More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Deployed Architect to join our Professional Services team. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, deploy, and optimize production-grade AI infrastructure and agent systems. You'll be responsible for architecting scalable, secure infrastructure deployments and building reliable, well-evaluated agent applications that solve real business problems. This role combines software development, infrastructure/platform engineering, and customer-facing skills. You'll work on everything from Kubernetes cluster design to multi-agent system architecture, requiring deep technical expertise across both infrastructure and agent engineering domains. This role offers direct impact on customer success, the opportunity to shape best practices, and work with cutting-edge AI technology. You'll join a collaborative team environment with a strong engineering culture. Location: New York City WHAT YOU'LL DO - Infrastructure & Platform Engineering: Design scalable, highly-available infrastructure for AI platform deployments (compute, storage, networking, security), enterprise integration patterns, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm), multi-region HA/DR strategies, and CI/CD pipelines - Agent Engineering & Development: Design multi-agent systems using different patterns, implement agent logic using modern frameworks (langchain/langgraph), design comprehensive evaluation frameworks, optimize prompts with A/B testing, and guide deployment/operations - Customer Engagement & Assessment: Lead technical maturity assessments, work directly with enterprise customers to understand requirements and present recommendations, and partner with Engagement Managers and Product/Engineering teams WHAT YOU'LL BRING REQUIRED EXPERIENCE - 7+ years of experience in a technical, hands-on customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect or Forward Deployed Engineer. - We also like former founders, so if you have an unusual background, but all the right skillsets, you are welcome to apply INFRASTRUCTURE & PLATFORM: - 3+ years of experience designing and deploying production infrastructure on cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) - Strong Kubernetes experience (GKE, EKS, or AKS) including cluster design, autoscaling, and multi-zone deployments - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm) and GitOps practices - Knowledge of database systems (relational databases, in-memory data stores) including HA, replication, backup strategies, and sizing - Experience designing high-availability and disaster recovery solutions - Strong understanding of networking, security (SSO/RBAC, TLS, secrets management), and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) - Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and applications AGENT ENGINEERING & DEVELOPMENT: - 1+ years of experience building production AI/ML applications or agents - Strong experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or similar) for building agent-based applications - Experience with state management patterns (short-term and long-term memory) - Experience designing and implementing evaluation frameworks for AI applications - Strong prompt engineering skills with experience in optimization and A/B testing - Experience with vector stores, RAG patterns, and knowledge organization - Experience with tool integration, API design, and error handling patterns - Strong Python and/or TypeScript development skills CUSTOMER-FACING: - Customer-facing experience with enterprise customers - Experience conducting technical assessments or infrastructure audits - Strong communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences KEY ATTRIBUTES - Strong problem-solving skills with ability to analyze complex requirements and design elegant solutions - Excellent customer-facing communication skills, able to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences - Experience working cross-functionally with engineering teams, product teams, and customers - Consultative approach with ability to understand customer needs, provide recommendations, and guide implementation - Ability to balance infrastructure architecture with agent development work - Strong engineering background with hands-on development experience - Willing to travel up to 20% of the time Looking to lead technical strategy across the customer journey from Proofs of Value (PoVs) to driving overall adoption? Please check out the Deployed Engineer listing focused on Account Strategy & Solutions. COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations. BENEFITS Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

ABOUT THE ROLE Designs, builds and improves what the GTM Agent does to create pipeline, from the first signal about a prospect to a booked meeting. Owns the software and agents behind outbound on every channel: inbound lead follow-up, prospecting, multi-channel sequences, email deliverability, calling and the quality of every message the agent writes, with people deciding what goes out. Serves Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), Account Executives (AEs), their managers and Marketing. The goal of the role is business impact for those teams: more positive replies, more meetings booked and more qualified pipeline for every dollar spent. Additionally, this role has a communication and evangelizing component: showing the teams it serves what works, and sharing content and open source projects with our developer community. This role suits an engineer who has already built agents or software for outbound and prospecting, such as sequencing, email deliverability, dialing or AI-written outreach. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Spends time with SDRs, AEs and their managers to find the prospecting work they repeat that the agent can take over. - Designs, builds and improves the agent's outbound workflows: what starts each run, what the agent reads and decides, what it drafts, and what waits for a rep's approval. - Builds the agentic system that follows up every inbound lead within minutes: it qualifies the lead, researches the person and the account, and drafts a first touch for the owner the routing rules assign. - Builds and improves the system that runs Marketing's outbound plays and campaigns for every rep, from the target list to the first touch. - Builds the software and agentic system behind multi-channel sequences, which combine email, LinkedIn and calls, choose each next touch from what the prospect did, and stop when the prospect replies on any channel. - Builds the email sending and deliverability system: sending domains and mailboxes, warm-up, daily limits, address checks, bounces, opt-outs and inbox placement across mail providers. - Builds the calling software reps use: call lists, dialing and the research a rep reads before each call. - Owns the quality of what the agent writes, so every message fits the prospect's signal, their history with us and the right product, and uses how much reps edit each message and the replies it gets to find what to fix. - Builds the safeguards that keep prospects from getting duplicate or overlapping outreach, and the sync that logs every email, LinkedIn action and call in Salesforce. - Builds experiments that test messages, channels, timing and sequences against held-out groups, measures which ones book meetings, and fixes or removes what doesn't. - Writes evals for every feature shipped, and ships each feature with its scorecard row. - Shows reps and their managers what works, and shares it through blog posts, webinars and open source. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - AI-Native Developer: You have a deep understanding of the LLM stack: prompting, retrieval (RAG), cognitive architectures, and agentic loops. You have likely already built with LangChain or LangGraph. - Engineering Foundation: You are a strong software engineer (typically 3+ years) with at least 1 year of experience specifically shipping LLM systems in production. - Self-Directed "Founder" Mentality: You don't need a ticket to tell you what to fix. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying high-impact problems, and driving them to completion autonomously. - Full-Stack Capability: Strong coding skills in Python or TypeScript (ideally both) and the ability to build end-to-end applications. - Customer-Centric: You enjoy the intersection of high-level engineering and direct customer impact. You can translate a customer's technical pain point into a scalable system architecture. NICE TO HAVES - Expertise with LangSmith for evaluation and monitoring. - Experience building or maintaining open-source projects. - A background in technical consulting, solutions engineering, or high-growth GTM teams. This role is the technical foundation behind that ecosystem. You'll build the reference architectures, integration patterns, and enablement programs that make partner motions work technically: co-sell with cloud hyperscalers, and independent delivery capability at systems integrators and global systems integrators (GSIs). You build with and for a partner, whose technical team then takes what you built to dozens of their own clients. Experience at or alongside a hyperscaler is a strong plus. We also like former founders and technical leaders, so if you have an unusual background but the right skill set, you're welcome to apply.
